usedFor: Fourthwall holds your shop products, and Slack gets a message with buttons when “Send Interactive Message” runs.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new product is created” in Fourthwall, then “Send Interactive Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: A new product reaches Slack with buttons, so the team can approve it before it goes further.

watchOut: “When a product is updated” fires on every edit, so one product can post to Slack several times.
